title: Senior Performance Creative (US Market)
subtitle: I.
body:
### **I. GENERAL INTRODUCTION**

PATI Group is entering a hyper-growth phase with a goal to **20x our revenue** within the next 12 months in international markets (US/EU/AU). We are not looking for ordinary video editors. We are searching for Creative Experts with a **Performance Mindset** who can master AI to produce large-scale video advertisements and conquer global audiences.

At PATI, you will work in an **AI-First** environment (comprehensive AI integration), with full autonomy over your creative direction and direct accountability for business results.

### **II. JOB DESCRIPTION**

You are more than just an Editor; you are a **Creative Systems Architect**:

- **Large-Scale Production:** Generate **100+ video ad variations per month** through AI-integrated workflows.

- **Performance Commitment:** Take ownership of viewer retention metrics (**Hook Rate >30%, Hold Rate >50%**). The videos produced must drive sales.

- **AI Workflow Architecture:** Design how the team utilizes AI tools (Midjourney, Runway, ElevenLabs) to optimize speed and quality.

- **Data-Driven Optimization:** Analyze creative metrics (CTR, Thumbstop Ratio) to decide whether to kill poor-performing ads or duplicate winners.

- **Team Leadership:** Build a library of templates and frameworks to guide and mentor the Trainee team.

### **III. JOB REQUIREMENTS**

- **Experience:** Minimum **5 years** in producing high-converting **Direct Response** video ads (US/EU market experience preferred).

- **Skills:**

**Video Editing:** Proficient in Premiere Pro, After Effects, and CapCut Pro. Must have a portfolio of winning ads as proof.

- **AI Tools:** Proficient in using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini, and Claude, or video editing AI like Sora, Veo, and Kling.

- **Global Mindset:** Fluent in English (**IELTS 6.5+** or equivalent) with a deep understanding of American pop culture.

- **Performance Portfolio:** Proven portfolio of high-converting Direct Response video ads.

- **Data-Driven:** Ability to read and analyze creative data (CTR, Hook Rate, Hold Rate, CPA, ROAS) to drive decisions.

- **[PREFERENCE]:** Experience in Global DTC/E-commerce. Knowledge of AI tools like Midjourney, Runway, and HeyGen. Proven team leadership ability.

### **IV. COMPENSATION & BENEFITS**

- **Unlimited Income:** Competitive base salary based on capability (starting from **20,000,000 VND**) + Annual Performance Bonus (based on % of revenue growth you generate). You have the right to value yourself and negotiate with us.

- **Ownership Opportunity:** Eligibility for **Equity** (ownership stake) upon becoming a Key Member.

- **Premium Work Tools:** Provided with a MacBook, Premium AI accounts (Claude Pro, ChatGPT Plus, etc.), VinFast car & Gym membership (subject to company policy).

- **Comprehensive Benefits:** Social Insurance, Bao Viet Health Insurance (Green Card), bi-annual company trips, and full holiday/birthday bonuses.

### **V. ADDITIONAL INFORMATION**

- **Recruitment Process: **To ensure we find the right “Builders” for our x20 goal, our process includes:

**Round 1 - Application & Technical Challenge: **After submitting your CV (with Portfolio attached), you will receive a technical challenge.

- **Round 2 - In-depth Interview: **A discussion regarding technical expertise and cultural fit with PATI’s management team.

- **Round 3 - Founder’s Table: **Direct strategic discussion with the CEO.

- **Working Conditions:**

**Time:**

Monday - Friday: 8:30 AM - 5:30 PM, with a 1-hour lunch break.

- Saturday (Culture Day): 6:30 AM - 09:00 AM. We kick off Saturdays with team runs and weekly reflections - mind, body, and momentum aligned.

- **Location:** PATI Group Office – Ho Chi Minh City.

- **Note:** This is a full-time, onsite position to ensure the highest speed of coordination.
